name: Nexo ARG for WooCommerce
author: Arioli.dev

sections.description:
En español: Nexo ARG es el ERP para WooCommerce pensado para Argentina: una solución integral, todo en español. Gestioná mejor tus ventas online: productos, stock, pedidos, fotos, correo y seguridad en un solo panel, con una tienda que abre al instante. Gratis, sin registro ni tarjeta. Complementos opcionales: facturación electrónica ARCA (ex AFIP), Mercado Libre, cobros con Mercado Pago, MODO y cuotas, envíos con Correo Argentino. Instalación: Plugins › Añadir nuevo, buscá «Nexo ARG», instalalo, activalo y abrí Nexo ARG en el menú. Documentación en castellano: ¿Qué es Nexo ARG? · todas las guías.

Nexo ARG for WooCommerce is an all-in-one ERP for WooCommerce stores in Argentina, made by Arioli.dev. The whole interface, the guides and the customer emails are in Spanish (Argentina), and it is built around how stores sell there: pesos, Argentine VAT, ARCA electronic invoicing, Mercado Pago, Mercado Libre and Correo Argentino. It replaces a long list of small plugins with one panel, works on top of WooCommerce and your theme (classic or block based) and only uses the standard WordPress and WooCommerce APIs.

Free, no registration, no license key

  • Products and stock – stock, price, sale price (with dates) and status of the whole catalog in one table, edited inline. Guided product creation with photos, sizes and colors. Spreadsheet export/import for bulk changes. Back-in-stock requests.
  • Catalog – categories, brands, tags and attributes (size, color) in one place.
  • Orders – all orders with clear statuses (awaiting payment, unpaid, paid, ready to ship, shipped with tracking, delivered), notes and a printable packing slip. Unpaid orders are released automatically after a configurable time. Manual payment confirmation (bank transfer or cash) with proof upload. Manual orders for sales made by WhatsApp, phone or in the shop.
  • Promotions and coupons – automatic promotions applied in the cart without a code (percentage, N or more units, buy N pay M) by product, category and dates, plus the WooCommerce coupons from the same screen.
  • Sales reports – sales by period with comparison, by product, category, payment method, delivery, status, province and customer.
  • Lightweight images – every new photo is optimized in the background: oversized photos are resized, every size is compressed and gets a WebP copy that the store shows instead of the JPG or PNG (works on any host, without server rules). Lazy loading for images below the fold. Existing photos are completed with one click. Originals are kept so you can restore them.
  • Speed and cache – page cache built for WooCommerce: cart, checkout, account and visitors with items in the cart never get a cached page, and every product, stock, price, category, menu or theme change refreshes exactly what shows it. Header cart without extra requests, browser cache rules and optional Cloudflare integration. A speed check measures the store like a customer sees it.
  • Customer account – a redesigned My Account: summary, orders with explained statuses and timeline, tracking and printable receipt.
  • Email – send through your own SMTP, edit the sender and the text of every customer email, with preview and your design.
  • Promo bar – a top bar with your messages (and, with add-ons, installments and free-shipping rules).
  • Contact – floating WhatsApp button (the customer starts the chat) and contact forms with bot protection.
  • Login security – branded login page, custom login URL and Cloudflare Turnstile verification.
  • Guides – every screen has a built-in guide that tells you what is missing and marks what is done.
  • Chatia – connect your own Chatia account (an Arioli.dev product, sold separately) and its assistant answers WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger with real store data (products, sizes, the customer’s own orders and tracking); your team replies from the same panel. The module itself is free.
  • Error log – the Registro screen records what went wrong (panel actions, emails that could not be sent, ARCA, Chatia, updates, PHP notices from the plugin) with date and detail; the Home screen warns when there were errors in the last 24 hours, and «Copy for support» prepares a report.

Optional add-ons

Sold separately at arioli.dev and delivered by the companion plugin Addons Nexo ARG for WooCommerce, all enabled with one license key entered under Nexo ARG › License:

  • Online payments – Mercado Pago, MODO, Nave, Payway, Getnet, Openpay and GOcuotas, with discounts by payment method and installments. An order is marked paid only when the payment provider confirms it.
  • Shipping and Correo Argentino – zones, distance-based courier, local pickup, free shipping by amount and integrated Correo Argentino with tracking.
  • ARCA electronic invoicing (formerly AFIP) – an invoice for every order with CAE, credit and debit notes, VAT sales book and the history you already issued.
  • Mercado Libre – publish from the store or link your existing listings; stock and price stay in sync and every Mercado Libre sale becomes a store order.
  • And more – SEO and Google, catalog filters and color swatches, size guides, resellers and wholesale prices, returns, abandoned carts, product feeds for Meta and Google, Instagram and Facebook feeds, team and audit log.

The free plugin is fully functional without any add-on.

External services

The free plugin connects to the following services only when you enable the related feature:

  • Arioli.dev license service (https://admin.arioli.dev/api/woonexo/) – only if you enter a license key for the add-ons. It sends your license key, your site domain, an anonymous installation ID and the plugin, WordPress, WooCommerce and PHP versions, when you activate or verify the key and once a day. It does not send any customer, visitor or order data, nor the plugin’s error log (the error log stays on your site; the separate Addons plugin, if you install it, can share a summary with Arioli.dev support). Terms: https://arioli.dev/terminos – Privacy: https://arioli.dev/politica-de-privacidad
  • Cloudflare Turnstile (https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/api.js) – only if you enable bot protection on the login page or contact forms with your own Turnstile keys. The Turnstile script is loaded from Cloudflare and the visitor’s response token is verified against Cloudflare’s API. Terms: https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/ – Privacy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/
  • Cloudflare API (https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/) – only if you paste a Cloudflare API token under Nexo ARG › Velocidad y caché. The plugin uses it to find your zone, purge the URLs that changed, create or remove its own cache rule and apply the zone settings you choose. It sends your token, your domain and the URLs of your store pages that changed; no customer or order data. Terms: https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/ – Privacy: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/
  • Chatia (https://admin.arioli.dev/api/woonexo/chatia/activar and https://<your-account>.chatia.arioli.dev/api/integracion/v1/) – only if you connect your own Chatia account under Nexo ARG › Chatia with your Chatia license key. Activation sends the license key, your site domain, store URL and name and an anonymous installation ID. While connected, the plugin creates a read-only WooCommerce REST API key and sends it to your Chatia account so its assistant can answer about products, sizes and the customer’s own orders; the chat screens in the plugin read and send messages of your Chatia account. Disconnecting deletes the key. Terms: https://arioli.dev/terminos – Privacy: https://arioli.dev/politica-de-privacidad
  • WhatsApp (https://wa.me/) – the contact button opens a WhatsApp chat with your number in the visitor’s browser or app. No data is sent by the plugin itself. Privacy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy

No data is sent anywhere else. The plugin does not track visitors and, without a license key, does not connect to Arioli.dev at all.

Source code and build

There is no build step. Every file in the plugin is the original, human-readable source: the PHP in src/ and templates/, the JavaScript in assets/js/ and the CSS in assets/css/ are written by hand and shipped as they are (not minified, compiled or bundled).

Third-party assets included:

  • DM Sans and DM Mono fonts (assets/fonts/), by Colophon Foundry, SIL Open Font License 1.1 – https://github.com/googlefonts/dm-fonts
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Go to Plugins › Add New, search for «Nexo ARG», install and activate it (or upload the ZIP under Plugins › Add New › Upload Plugin).
  3. Open Nexo ARG in the WordPress menu. The Home screen lists what to configure first, and every screen has a Guide button.
  4. Recommended order: products, email, payment methods and shipping, order statuses, speed and cache, images. Step by step (in Spanish): documentation.
  5. Optional: to use add-ons, buy them at arioli.dev, install the Addons Nexo ARG for WooCommerce plugin you receive and paste your license key under Nexo ARG › License.
sections.faq:
Is it really free?

Yes. Products, catalog, orders, promotions and coupons, sales reports, images, speed and cache, customer account, email, promo bar, contact, login security, the Chatia module and the error log are free, with no registration and no license key.

Is it in Spanish?

Yes, everything: the panel, the guides, the customer emails and the documentation are in Spanish (Argentina).

Does it work outside Argentina?

It is built for Argentina (pesos, VAT, ARCA, Mercado Pago, Mercado Libre, Correo Argentino). The core works on any WooCommerce store, but the payment, shipping and invoicing add-ons are for Argentina.

How do updates work?

Like any plugin from WordPress.org: WordPress shows the new version under Dashboard › Updates and Plugins, and you update it there (or let WordPress update it automatically). Products, orders, settings and keys are kept.

What do the add-ons add?

Online payments, shipping and Correo Argentino, ARCA e-invoicing, Mercado Libre, SEO, catalog filters, size guides, resellers, returns, customers and abandoned carts, product feeds for Meta and Google, and Instagram and Facebook feeds. Each one is sold separately at arioli.dev and all of them share one license key.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes, with classic and block themes. The plugin uses WooCommerce hooks and templates; it does not modify your theme files.

Does it support HPOS?

Yes. The plugin only uses the WooCommerce order API, so it works with High-Performance Order Storage enabled or disabled, and with the block checkout.

Does the page cache break the cart or show old prices?

No. Pages with a cart, checkout or account, visitors with products in the cart and logged-in users never get a cached page, and when a product, its stock or its price changes, its page, its categories, the shop and the home page are refreshed. If another page-cache plugin is installed, Nexo ARG will not install its own until you deactivate the other one.

Do I need Cloudflare?

No. The page cache works on its own. If your site already uses Cloudflare, connecting it with an API token lets the plugin purge Cloudflare automatically and, optionally, cache store pages at the edge.

Will it deactivate other plugins?

No. Nexo ARG never activates or deactivates plugins on its own. If a plugin that does the same job as a module you turned on is active (for example a contact-form or login-hiding plugin), the Home screen lists it with two buttons: «Desactivar» (deactivate it yourself, its settings are kept) or «Seguir usando los dos» (keep both).

Where do I get help?

In the documentation (in Spanish) and at arioli.dev. If something fails, Nexo ARG › Registro › Copiar para soporte prepares a report you can send us.
sections.changelog:
1.8.10

  • Products: a product that was already saved (for example as simple or as a draft) and is then turned into a product with variations is now saved as a variable product. Before, its variations were saved but the product stayed simple, because WooCommerce kept the old product type in its cache.

1.8.9

  • Add-ons: new «Live statistics» add-on (in the separate Addons plugin): who is in the store right now, what they are looking at, where they came from and how far they got in the purchase, plus the daily, weekly and monthly summary. The free plugin only lists it and shows its setup guide.

1.8.8

  • Add-ons: new «Advertising on Meta and Google» screen, included in the «Catalog for Meta and Google» add-on (the add-on itself is in the separate Addons plugin). The free plugin only lists it and shows its setup guide.

1.8.7

  • Security: «login» can now be used as the custom login address.
  • Security: Cloudflare Turnstile now also protects the WooCommerce My Account login, registration and lost password forms (and the checkout login). Before, My Account login was not checked and the lost password form failed with Turnstile on.
  • Page cache: works on sites with Elementor (Elementor turns off the WordPress template buffer the cache uses).

1.8.6

  • Plugin page: clearer description of what Nexo ARG is (an all-in-one ERP for WooCommerce built for Argentina, in Spanish), Spanish summary and links to the Spanish documentation. No functional changes.

1.8.5

  • Images: uploading a photo no longer waits for the optimization (with heavy files and many image sizes the upload could exceed the hosting time limit and fail with error 504). The photo is optimized in the background a few seconds later.

1.8.4

  • The free plugin no longer sends the error-log summary to arioli.dev: it only sends what the license check needs. The error log stays on your site.
  • Hidden login: the admin, admin-ajax.php and admin-post.php paths are taken from admin_url().
  • Emails: no style block; link colors are inline and the responsive rules go through WooCommerce’s email styles filter.
  • Error log: no longer calls error_reporting().
  • My Account: everything printed by the order screens is escaped; the return form script is enqueued.
  • License › «Verify now» tells the Addons plugin to look for new versions right away.

1.8.3

  • Coupons and promotions and Sales reports are now free (they were paid add-ons). Existing promotions and settings are kept.

1.8.2

  • Requires WordPress 6.9. Page cache and WebP delivery use the WordPress template output buffer; the plugin no longer writes advanced-cache.php or edits wp-config.php.
  • The free plugin is updated from WordPress.org like any other plugin.

1.8.1

  • Fix: uploading a payment receipt from the order page («Ya pagué») no longer fails.

1.8.0

  • Plugins that do the same job as a module are no longer deactivated automatically: the Home screen suggests it and you decide.
  • All scripts and styles are loaded with the WordPress enqueue functions; stricter escaping and sanitization.

Earlier versions

  • 1.0 to 1.7: first releases (products, orders, images, cache, customer account, email, Chatia, error log, manual orders and screen options).
